$comment: Audited in-place changes to published schemas. A schema is immutable at its $id: any byte change needs a new version, EXCEPT a compatible widening that upstream (@kya-os/mcp) applied in place and that is recorded here. Each entry is one exact transition, current published SHA-256 -> donated SHA-256; entries for the same path chain in order and are append-only. scripts/emit-schemas.mjs refuses any change not listed; test/in-place-transitions.test.ts checks the chain ends at the published bytes.

transitions.reason: Additive: the optional `audit` capability object (auditability suite).
Widening: `proofProfile` from const "org.kya-os/proof@1" to an enum that also accepts "org.kya-os/proof.v1" (terminal proof-profile naming, one-major compat window).
Widening: `version` also accepts a three-part protocol version ("1.0.0"), and `endpoints.handshake` is no longer required (the stateless card-proof profile has no handshake).

Widening: `credentialStatus.type` also accepts "BitstringStatusListEntry" (the W3C StatusList2021 successor) and `credentialStatus.id` is optional, per the Bitstring Status List spec; the CRISP scope matcher also accepts "path-prefix".
